title: Idle machine action
statement: For a natural number $k$, state type $\mathrm{St}$, input-head direction $d\in\{-1,0,1\}$, optional Boolean output $o$, and optional successor state $s$, define an action on $k$ work tapes that moves the input head by $d$, leaves every work tape unchanged with its head stationary, emits $o$, and has successor state $s$ (halting when $s$ is absent).
